title: Authorization of a development, enlargement or site alteration on a Tier II site or portion of a zoning lot having a steep slope or steep slope buffer
previewText:

blocks.html: The lot coverage regulations of Section 105-33 (Residential Lot Coverage Regulations on Sites Granted an Authorization Pursuant to Section 105-422) shall apply to any residential development, enlargement or site alteration granted an authorization pursuant to this Section.

blocks.html: Any development, enlargement or site alteration requiring an authorization pursuant to this Section shall be subject to all the requirements of this Chapter for which an authorization or special permit has not been obtained.
